name: hubitat-home
description: Installable phone dashboard for your Hubitat hub, running free on your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-thermo-plan.mjs && node scripts/test-energy.mjs && node scripts/test-config.mjs && node scripts/test-voice.mjs && node scripts/test-push-crypto.mjs

SETUP_CODE.description: Pick any code (for example four random words) and write it down. The **setup wizard** asks for it the first time you open your dashboard, so nobody else can claim it.

KV.description: Storage for your house settings, access keys and alert state. The default name is fine.
